settings.heading: When the pan moves with you
settings.lede:
New address. Same pan. Kartavya Jharwal unpacked it and wondered if it would work on the new hob. Somewhere in the move, the answer had gone missing.

That’s where we began. A pan should come with enough knowledge to get dinner on the table in the next kitchen.
